info.name: List product calculation line items V3

params.name: filter
params.description:
The filter parameter is used to filter the results of the given endpoint. 


**Supported filter operators by key:** 

`archived`: *equals*, *notEquals* 

`designation`: *equals*, *notEquals*, *in*, *notIn*, *contains*, *notContains*, *startsWith*, *endsWith* 

`costType`: *equals*, *notEquals*, *in*, *notIn* 

`includeInCalculation`: *equals*, *notEquals*

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort via id, -id, date, -date, designation, -designation, costType and -costType. Default sort is -id

params.name: perPage
params.description: Number of items per page. Default: 15, Max: 5000

params.name: page
params.description: Page number. Only used with simple and table pagination.

params.name: cursor
params.description: The cursor to use for the paginated call. Only used with cursor pagination. Not compatible with page parameter
